title: 麦当劳AI点餐员：8秒听错单，3秒接对单，下次点餐还靠谱吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: By this time next year, you could be talking to AI when you pull up at a McDonald's right through. I tested Archie, McDonald's AI order taker, and one of the first US locations using it.
segments.zh: 明年此时，你在麦当劳得来速点餐时，可能就在和AI对话。我测试了麦当劳的AI点餐员Archie，它是美国首批使用该系统的门店之一。

segments.en: The first time, it took about eight seconds to respond. Uh, yeah, my code is f***ing.
segments.zh: 第一次，它花了大约八秒才回应。呃，是的，我的代码是……

segments.en: And I'm sure I heard that right. Could you share your code again?
segments.zh: 我确定我听对了。你能再说一遍代码吗？

segments.en: One moment, I'll get a crew member to help me.
segments.zh: 稍等，我找工作人员来帮忙。

segments.en: When my list visit, it answered in about three seconds. It got my order right, and felt like a real-time conversation, though it did stumble over some words.
segments.zh: 我上次来时，它大约三秒就回答了。它准确处理了我的订单，感觉像实时对话，尽管有些词它说得不太顺。

segments.en: What can I get for you? Um, yeah, can I please get the my crispy deluxe meal, please?
segments.zh: 您想要点什么？嗯，请给我一份脆皮豪华套餐。

segments.en: With that you merged deluxe and crispy meal? Okay, we will make that a medium.
segments.zh: 您把豪华和脆皮套餐合并了？好的，我们做成中份。

segments.en: With that with coke? Yeah, our diet coke, please.
segments.zh: 配可乐吗？是的，请给我们健怡可乐。

segments.en: A medium deluxe and crispy meal with a diet coke. Anything else for you today?
segments.zh: 一份中份豪华脆皮套餐配健怡可乐。今天还要别的吗？

segments.en: Do you have the much spicy way? We do not have much spicy meals.
segments.zh: 你们有特辣味吗？我们没有特辣套餐。

segments.en: Would you like to try our crispy strips or make nuggets instead?
segments.zh: 您想试试我们的脆条还是换成鸡块？
